sections.title: Our Beef
sections.intro: We slaughter our own cattle, sourced from farmers in and around our local community. Short transport routes, small-scale farming and personal contact with our farmers are nothing special for us — it's simply how we've always done things. Our current beef comes from Leobendorf, Familie Pöllner.
